transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the standard review for the Blending Vessel 4 internal cleaning scheduled for this weekend. As we all know, the vessel is isolated from normal production service, and our routine confined-space entry procedure applies. Before I can authorize personnel to enter the vessel, I need to hear from each of you — maintenance, quality, production planning, and industrial hygiene — on any confirmed requirements in your respective areas. Let's go around the table.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During my maintenance inspection, I found that the vessel's lower drain actuator must be replaced before entry. The replacement takes exactly 3 hours, and the vessel has four separate energy-isolation points that must be locked out. I recorded this in a pending maintenance note that hasn't been entered in the central work-order system yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: My quality review of the campaign change found that the previous batch was an allergen-containing formulation. Quality requires exactly three documented rinse samples, and the vessel must remain on quality hold until all three pass before it can be released. I completed the review in the batch file, but it hasn't been attached to the weekend work package yet.
